item.text:
Created the async server component in [UserPreferences.tsx](/workspace/app/UserPreferences.tsx:1). It displays the `theme` cookie, defaulting to `light`, and the highest-priority language from the `Accept-Language` header. If that header is absent or has no usable language, it displays “Not specified.”

The home page now renders the component in [page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:1). I did not run tests.
